title: Store the GitHub token in `chrome.storage.sync`
notes: so a second machine needs no setup.
resolution: Superseded. `local` and `sync` both default to `TRUSTED_AND_UNTRUSTED_CONTEXTS`, so a content script could read the token. It now lives in `chrome.storage.local` behind `setAccessLevel('TRUSTED_CONTEXTS')`, entered once per machine; only non-secret config syncs.
